## FIXED CLIDEO WATERMARK PROFILE — 720×1280

This workflow is specialized for the current 720×1280, ~20 s video with a static `clideo.com` watermark in the lower-right corner.

### What changed
- Fixed crop: **X=464, Y=1024, W=256, H=256**. Only the lower-right 256×256 region is sent through VOID.
- The **inner SAM3 mask is bypassed**. It was the cause of the boot being intermittently included in the inpaint mask when the person moved near the watermark region.
- Fixed local mask inside the 256×256 crop: approximately **X=48, Y=192, W=200, H=56**, feathered 8 px.
- T5/CLIP: **t5xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.safetensors → GPU 1 / RTX 3080 Ti**.
- VOID Pass 1 + Pass 2 and CogVideoX VAE: **GPU 0 / RTX 3090**.
- Sampling remains quality-first: **Pass 1 = 24 steps, Pass 2 = 18 steps, CFG = 6**.
- Auto-crop SAM3 remains OFF. With the lazy switch, its branch is not executed.

### Attention / speed
The JSON cannot select ComfyUI's global attention backend. Launch ComfyUI with **`--use-sage-attention`** if SageAttention is installed and verify the console reports Sage attention. Do not use MultiGPU CFG Split here: each VOID UNet is large enough that cloning it onto the 12 GB 3080 Ti leaves almost no activation headroom.

### Important
The fixed mask coordinates are deliberately specific to this watermark position and this 720×1280 composition. For another watermark position, adjust the crop/mask rather than re-enabling semantic SAM3 tracking.

nodes.title: Note: About VOID Model
widgets_values:
Project: [Netflix/void-model](https://github.com/Netflix/void-model)

## What this stack is good at

Segmentation (**SAM3** from your text cue) defines **what** to erase; the **two-pass** video model **inpaints holes over time**. Strengths:

- **Object removal**, not single-frame patching: coherent motion and lighting across the clip.
- **Interaction-aware seams**: occluded pixels are filled as if the object (and often its immediate influence on nearby stuff) **was never there**, so shadows, overlaps, or simple causal cues can look **more plausible** than a naive erase.
- **Pass 2** refines temporal stability (fewer jitters/flashes) versus **Pass 1** alone — useful on longer cuts or textured backgrounds.

Limits: unclear masks, chaotic motion, or targets that dominate the frame still fail; prompting cannot fix fundamentally wrong segmentation.

## Inputs

- **Source video** — From ComfyUI `input` (`Load Video`).
- **Positive prompt (inpaint fill)** — The **filled** scene after removal (what remains / how it looks and moves).
- **Negative prompt** — Optional anti-artifact list; can be empty.
- **SAM3 object prompt** — Short label for **what** to mask out.

## Prompt writing

**Positive (inpaint)** — Describe the **result**, not “remove X”. Example: `empty kitchen counter, daylight, tiles visible`.

**SAM3 object** — Short referring phrase: `person in blue jacket`, `red cup on table`.

| Field | Role |
|--------|------|
| SAM3 | **What** is removed |
| Positive | **How** the hole is filled in time |

Use **Negative** only when you see repeating defects (watermark, blur, extra limbs, etc.).

## Current fixed-watermark build
This exported build intentionally bypasses the inner SAM3 temporal mask and uses a fixed ROI mask. The outer SAM3 auto-crop path is disabled. T5 uses the FP8 scaled checkpoint on GPU 1; VOID/VAE stay on GPU 0.
